steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: State: give a brief factual answer without explanation. | Key Fact: Describe: give a detailed account of what something is or how it works. | Key Fact: Explain: give reasons or causes - say how AND why. | Key Fact: Compare: identify similarities AND differences between two or more items.

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from exam command words, and one past-paper question.
